correctness.rationale: For every nonconstant binary word the 1-,2-,3-composition observations are explicitly recoverable from the number of ones, zero/one run counts, singleton-run counts, and endpoint correction. The reverse recovery is shown algebraically. Exhaustive end-status cases give 11 diagonal coefficient sums with exactly one inclusion-exclusion term. The run-inventory series counts each feasible signature once, each long-run excess independently, and the geometric diagonal formula holds for all indices. Cross-multiplication of the 11 rational terms is an exact integer-polynomial identity yielding the asserted generating function. A standard residue/partial-fraction coefficient extraction gives the stated period-four quartic for all n>=2, with n=1 handled separately. The standalone code passed the exact identity, exhaustive word/run checks for n=3..14, and independent DP for n=3..35. This proof does not infer generality from finite tests.

value.rationale: The source introduces length-limited molecular substring-composition readings and explicitly asks for fixed-cutoff performance. The first cutoff beyond the published exact binary r=2 case needs new singleton-run/end-condition structure; resolving it gives a full all-length rational enumeration and period-four quartic, sharp capacity constant n^4/32, and the exact maximum size of every noiseless block code. This is a natural complete classification of observations, not a renaming of an adjacent-pair formula or a finite sample.
